DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのようなことが起きたか、順に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what happened, in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 隣人へ注意してほしいです。それだけ伝えれば、私が困った事情も分かってもらえると思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 隣人へ注意の希望だけで事情も伝わると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want you to warn my neighbor. I came thinking that just saying that would also make you understand the circumstances troubling me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought stating only your wish for the neighbor to be warned would convey the circumstances too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご希望だけでは、起きた出来事は分かりません。まず、どんなやり取りがありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your request alone does not tell us what happened. First, what exchanges took place?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 共有の通路へ置いた私の箱について、隣人と口論しました。私も声を大きくしました。相手だけが何も理由なく怒ったという説明ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 共有通路の自分の箱で口論し本人も声を上げたと経緯を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I argued with my neighbor about my box that I had put in the shared passageway. I raised my voice too. I am not saying the other person got angry for no reason at all.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe how you argued over your own box in the shared passageway and raised your voice yourself too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身の行動も含めて伺います。箱は現在もその場所にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will ask about your actions too. Is the box still there now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今は自分の家へ戻しました。口論した時の状況と今の状態は違います。相手を罰してほしいと言えば解決する、と自分で決めていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 箱は今撤去済みで当時と現在を分け処罰を解決保証としないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have taken it back into my home now. The situation during the argument differs from the situation now. I had decided for myself that asking you to punish the other person would resolve it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the box has now been removed, distinguish then from now, and do not treat punishment as a guaranteed solution. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対応は事情を確認して担当がご案内します。今後どうしたいかもお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person responsible will check the circumstances and explain the response. Please also tell us what you would like to do from now on.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: また顔を合わせた時に、同じ口論になるのが不安です。私から強い言葉を言いに行く前に、相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 再会での口論が不安で強く言いに行く前に相談したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am worried we will have the same argument when we meet again. I want to consult you before I go and speak harshly to them myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you are worried about another argument when you meet again and want advice before going to speak harshly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出来事、ご自身のご希望、現在の不安を分けて担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the person responsible separately about the events, your wishes, and your current concerns.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。箱を置いたこと、自分も声を上げたこと、今は戻したことを話し、対応は担当と相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人の行動と今の状態と希望を分け担当の対応相談を受けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will explain that I put the box there, raised my voice too, and have now taken it back, and discuss the response with the person responsible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will distinguish your actions, the current situation, and your wishes, and consult the person responsible about the response. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容を引き継ぎます。それでは、担当の案内をお待ちください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass that on. Please wait for instructions from the person responsible. Thank you for coming to consult us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒の準備で、お迷いでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you unsure about preparing the envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 余った紙に友人への手紙を書きました。でも裏に、家族の予定と電話番号が印刷されています。表の文章だけ送るつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再利用便箋の裏に家族情報があり表だけ送るつもりだったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote a letter to a friend on spare paper. But my family's schedule and phone number are printed on the back. I intended to send only the writing on the front.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that family information is on the back of the reused letter paper and you intended to send only the front. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紙の両面が中身になります。本文をどう整えるかは、ご自身で確認してからお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Both sides of the paper form part of the contents. Please check for yourself before deciding how to prepare the letter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ封はしていません。紙を再利用したかっただけで、家族の情報まで友人へ知らせたいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未封で再利用目的であり家族情報共有の意図はないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not sealed it yet. I only wanted to reuse the paper; I do not want to tell my friend my family's information too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it is unsealed, your purpose was reuse, and you did not intend to share family information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発送する内容を整理してから、郵便物の準備をご相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Once you have sorted out what to send, we can discuss preparing the mail.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、新しい紙へ書き直します。裏を見えなく折ればよいと決めず、送る紙に不要な情報を残さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新紙へ書き直し折って隠すだけでは済ませないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I will rewrite it on new paper. I will not assume folding it to hide the back is enough; I will make sure no unnecessary information remains on the paper I send.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will rewrite it on new paper rather than merely folding it to hide the back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書き直した後も、中身はご自身でお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the contents yourself after rewriting it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。表の文章が合っているかだけでなく、別の紙を間違って重ねていないかも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本文と紙の混入の両方を発送前に本人が確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will check not only whether the writing on the front is correct, but also whether I have accidentally included another sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will personally check both the letter text and any accidentally included paper before sending. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご準備が終わりましたら、封をしてお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you have finished preparing it, please seal it and bring it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日はこの紙を持ち帰ります。手紙の本文だけを整えてから、発送の相談に戻ります。裏面に気づけてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日は持帰り必要本文だけを整えて再相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take this paper home today. I will return to discuss sending it after preparing only the actual letter text. I am glad I noticed the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take it home today, prepare only the necessary letter text, and return for advice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 新しい用紙に書き直してから、ほかの紙の裏側も確認してご準備ください。準備ができましたらお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: After rewriting it on fresh paper, check the backs of the other sheets too as you prepare it. Please bring it when it is ready. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日のご相談では、どのようなお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What help do you need with today's consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同僚に通訳を頼んで来ました。でも通帳の内容を全部同僚へ見せたいわけではありません。相談する範囲を先に伝えてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通訳同僚へ全通帳を共有する意図はなく範囲を先に話したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I asked a coworker to interpret and came with them. But I do not want to show my coworker everything in my bankbook. May I explain the scope of the consultation first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you do not intend to share the entire bankbook with the interpreting coworker and want to discuss the scope first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご希望を伺います。今日確認したい用件は何でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will listen to your wishes. What matter would you like to check today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 手続きの説明の言葉を理解したいです。口座の数字まで同僚が判断して、私の代わりに決める希望ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 説明の言葉の支援を求め口座内容の代理判断は求めないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to understand the language used to explain the procedure. I am not asking my coworker to assess even the account figures and make decisions for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want help understanding the explanation, not someone judging the account contents on your behalf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 用件と支援のご希望を担当へ伝えます。必要な本人確認などは、その際にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the person responsible about your matter and the help you want. They will explain any necessary identity checks then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。説明の分からない言葉だけ同僚に助けてもらい、本人の意思を聞かれたら自分で答えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未知語を支援してもらい本人の意思は本人が答えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will ask my coworker to help only with words I do not understand in the explanation, and answer for myself when asked about my wishes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will get help with unfamiliar words and personally answer questions about your own wishes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同僚の方へも、ご希望の範囲を伝えられましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you told your coworker what scope of help you want too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今伝えました。関係のない通帳はしまい、担当へ必要な資料を聞いてから出します。隠して手続きを進めたいという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同僚へ範囲を伝え関係ない資料をしまい必要資料を担当へ聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have just told them. I will put away unrelated bankbooks and ask the person responsible which documents are needed before taking them out. I do not mean that I want to proceed while hiding things.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you told your coworker the scope, put unrelated documents away, and will ask the person responsible what is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 資料の確認と、話す方法のご希望を合わせて担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please discuss both the documents to be checked and how you would like to communicate with the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。通訳を頼んだことを、全資料の共有や全ての代理判断への同意とはしません。必要な支援を説明して相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通訳依頼を全共有や全面代理の同意とせず支援範囲を示すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I will not treat asking for interpretation as consent to sharing all documents or having every decision made for me. I will explain the help I need and discuss it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say your request for interpretation is not consent to sharing everything or full representation, and explain the scope of help. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を引き継ぎます。それでは、担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass on your wishes. I will now take you to the person responsible. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品を、別の棚へ置こうとされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you about to put this product on another shelf?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 買うのをやめたので、近くの空いた所へ戻そうと思いました。冷たい品ですが、元の棚がどこだったか覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入をやめた冷たい品を空棚へ置くつもりで元棚を知らないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I decided not to buy it, so I thought I would put it in a nearby empty spot. It is a chilled item, but I do not remember where its original shelf was.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you intended to put a chilled item you decided not to buy on an empty shelf and do not know its original shelf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 空いた棚へは置かず、こちらへご相談ください。まだお会計はされていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not put it on an empty shelf; ask us here. You have not paid for it yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、未会計です。かごに入れた後で家族から要らないと聞いたので、買わないことにしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未会計で家族の不要連絡を受け購入を止めたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Correct, I have not paid. After putting it in my basket, my family told me we did not need it, so I decided not to buy it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it is unpaid and you stopped buying it after your family said it was unnecessary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お持ちの状況を確認します。いつからかごに入れていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check how you have been carrying it. Since when has it been in your basket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 売場を回る間です。正確な時間は測っていないので、短い時間だから大丈夫とは自分で決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 所持時間は正確に測らず短いから安全と判断しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: While I was walking around the sales floor. I did not measure the exact time, so I will not decide it is fine because it was only a short time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you did not measure the exact time you held it and will not judge it safe just because it seemed short. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 商品は係が確認します。ご自身で元の棚を推測して戻すのはお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: A staff member will check the product. Please wait and do not guess its original shelf and put it back yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。似た品の棚へ移すのもやめ、未会計と、持っていた時間が不明なことを伝えてお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 似た棚へも戻さず状態と時間不明を伝えて係へ渡すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will not move it to a shelf of similar items either. I will hand it over and explain that it is unpaid and I do not know how long I had it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not return it to a similar shelf either, and will tell staff its status and that the time is unknown when handing it over. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらで確認を受け付けます。ほかの購入する品は、お客様のかごへお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will accept it here for checking. Please keep the other items you are buying in your basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。買う品と取りやめる品を分けました。空いた場所なら戻してよいと思わず、店員さんへ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入継続品と取りやめ品を区別し空棚へ戻さず相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I have separated the items I am buying from the one I am no longer buying. I will ask a staff member rather than assume any empty spot is suitable for returning it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will distinguish purchases from canceled items and consult staff instead of returning it to an empty shelf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お知らせありがとうございます。それでは、残りのお買物をお続けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know. Please continue with the rest of your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 小川の案内について、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the stream instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 長靴を履いて来ました。水が浅そうなので、小川へ入って石を見てもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 長靴と浅く見える水を理由に小川で石を見る許可を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came wearing rubber boots. The water looks shallow, so may I enter the stream to look at stones?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask permission to look at stones in the stream, citing your boots and the apparently shallow water. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの案内では、この小川へ入らないようお願いしています。長靴のご用意とは別にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Our instructions ask you not to enter this stream. Please check that separately from having brought boots.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。靴がぬれないなら入ってよいと思っていました。浅そうというのも、岸から見た印象だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 靴がぬれなければよいと思い水の浅さも岸からの印象と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I thought it was okay to enter if my shoes would not get wet. The apparent shallowness is also just my impression from the bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought keeping your shoes dry was enough, and the shallow water is only an impression from the bank. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 水の中の状態をこちらで安全と保証することはできません。観察は案内された場所からお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot guarantee that conditions in the water are safe. Please observe from the designated place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。水へ入らず、こちらから見ます。気になる石を取りに行くのではなく、見える形をメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小川へ入らず案内場所から石の形を記録すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will look from here without entering the water. Instead of going to collect a stone that interests me, I will note the shapes I can see.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will record the stones' shapes from the designated place without entering the stream. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路や、ほかの方の観察も妨げないようご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also avoid blocking the path or other people's observations.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここで立ち止まります。岸から身を乗り出して近づくのもやめ、見えない部分は見えないまま記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路を妨げず身を乗り出さず不明部分を補わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will stop here. I will not lean out from the bank to get closer either; I will record parts I cannot see as unseen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not obstruct the path, lean out, or fill in unknown parts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その場所からご覧ください。ほかの案内が必要でしたらお声掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please observe from that spot. Let us know if you need other guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。長靴や水の見た目を許可の代わりにせず、案内の場所から観察を楽しみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 靴や見た目を許可とせず指定位置から観察すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will enjoy observing from the designated place without treating my boots or the water's appearance as permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will observe from the specified position without treating footwear or appearances as permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご理解ありがとうございます。それでは、ごゆっくりお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for understanding. Please enjoy your time here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご旅行の人数と予定を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me the number of travelers and your plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三人の旅行なので、往復三人分と言おうと思いました。でも、一人は帰りに同行しません。方向ごとに相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三人旅行だが一人は帰り同行せず往復人数を別に相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a trip for three, so I was going to ask for round trips for three people. But one person will not accompany us on the return. Can we discuss each direction separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say three people are traveling but one will not return with you, so you want to discuss outbound and return numbers separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 行きと帰りの人数を、別々に確認しましょう。行きは皆さま一緒ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the outbound and return numbers separately. Are you all traveling together on the way there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、行きは三人一緒で、帰りは私と友人の二人です。残る一人は、現地で家族と過ごします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 行き三人帰り二人で一人は現地家族と過ごすと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, all three of us are going together, and my friend and I, two people, will return. The other person will spend time with family there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that three go, two return, and one will stay there with family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それぞれの行き先と日付の予定も、ご自身のメモで確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also check each destination and planned date against your own notes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このメモをお見せします。一人が帰らないことを、帰りの日付だけ違うという意味にはしません。帰りの人数は二人です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 区間と日付メモを示し帰り人数減を日付変更だけとしないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will show you these notes. One person not returning does not mean merely that their return date differs. The return is for two people.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your notes on sections and dates, and say fewer return passengers does not merely mean a date change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 人数に合わせた取扱いは、担当が確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person responsible will check and explain how to handle the booking for those numbers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。三人旅行という言葉だけで、全員の往復券が必要だと決めず、利用する区間ごとに聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旅行全体の人数から全員往復券を決めず区間別に扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I will not decide everyone needs round-trip tickets just because it is a trip for three; I will ask about each section we will use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not decide everyone needs round trips from the overall group size, but will ask about handling each section. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご案内を聞いてから、発券のご希望をお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please decide what tickets you want issued after hearing the guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。行き三人、帰り二人の予定を連れにも読み合わせ、人数と日付が合っていると確認してからお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 人数と日付を同行者とも確認して発券希望を決めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will read the plan of three outbound and two returning together with my companions, and request it after checking that the numbers and dates are right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check numbers and dates with your companions before deciding what tickets to request. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その予定でご相談を承りました。それでは、担当へご案内します。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have accepted your inquiry on that plan. I will now take you to the person responsible. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地域の環境について、ご意見をお持ちですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have an opinion about the local environment, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 公園の日陰を増やしてほしいです。意見の紙に「住民全員が求めています」と書きましたが、ほかの人へはまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日陰増加の希望を全住民の総意と書いたが他者未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like more shade in the park. I wrote on the comment sheet, “All residents want this,” but I have not asked anyone else yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you wrote your wish for more shade as all residents' consensus but have not checked with others. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身の体験と、確認した他の方の意見を分けてお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please distinguish your own experience from other people's opinions that you have confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。私が昼に休みたい時、日陰が少なく感じたのがきっかけです。全員が同じ使い方とは確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昼の自分の休憩体験がきっかけで他者の使い方は不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. What prompted this was feeling there was little shade when I wanted to rest at midday. I have not confirmed that everyone uses it in the same way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your own midday rest experience prompted this and others' use is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身の希望として担当へお伝えできます。場所や時間帯も示していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can pass it on as your own wish. Could you specify the location and time of day too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらの通路沿いで、昼の時間です。私の使い方では休みにくい、と書き直します。代わりに皆を代表すると言うのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 場所と時間帯を示し本人希望として書き代表を自称しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Along this path, at midday. I will rewrite it to say it is difficult to rest there for the way I use it. I will stop saying that I represent everyone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify the place and time, write it as your own wish, and do not call yourself everyone's representative. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当がご意見を確認します。実際の整備について、こちらで決定をお約束することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person responsible will review your opinion. We cannot promise a decision here about actual improvements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。要望を受け取ったことを、木を増やす決定が出たと近所へ知らせたりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 要望受領を整備決定として近隣へ知らせないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will not tell the neighborhood that a decision to add trees has been made just because my request was received.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not tell neighbors that receiving the request means improvements have been decided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談したい内容として、具体的な状況をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please bring the specific circumstances as the matter you want to discuss.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。自分の体験と希望を伝え、他の人の意見は確認できた範囲で、別に書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人意見と確認済み他者意見を分けて担当へ示すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I will explain my own experience and wishes, and write others' opinions separately, limited to what I have confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will show the person responsible your own views separately from confirmed opinions of others. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご意見の内容を引き継ぎます。それでは、担当の案内をお待ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass on your comments. Please wait for guidance from the person responsible. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの睡眠メモについて、お聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me about the sleep notes you brought.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 七時間眠ったと書きました。でも、布団に入ってから携帯を見ていた時間も、眠った時間へ入れてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 布団から起床までを睡眠七時間と記録したが携帯使用時間も入れたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote that I slept seven hours. But I included the time I spent looking at my phone after getting into bed as time asleep.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you recorded seven hours from getting into bed to getting up as sleep but included phone use too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 寝床に入った時刻と、眠っていたことは分けて伺います。どの時刻は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will ask separately about when you got into bed and when you were asleep. Which times do you remember?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 布団に入ったのは午前零時、起きたのは七時です。二時頃まで携帯を見ましたが、眠り始めた瞬間は分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 就床零時起床七時と携帯使用二時頃を示し入眠時刻は不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I got into bed at midnight and got up at seven. I looked at my phone until around two, but I do not know the moment I fell asleep.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give midnight as bedtime, seven as waking time, phone use until about two, and say sleep onset is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かる時刻と不明な所を、そのまま担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the person responsible the times you know and the unknown parts as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。二時に携帯をしまったので、二時ちょうどに眠ったと決めることもしません。起きていた記憶として残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 携帯終了を入眠時刻とせず覚醒記憶として残すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I put my phone away at two, but I will not decide that I fell asleep at exactly two either. I will retain it as a memory of being awake.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not treat the end of phone use as sleep onset, but record it as a memory of wakefulness. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 夜中に目を覚ました記憶なども、担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person responsible will also ask about memories of waking during the night.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。思い出せない所を、ずっと眠ったという記録にせず、覚えている出来事だけを足します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不明部分を連続睡眠として埋めず覚えている出来事を記すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will not record the parts I cannot remember as uninterrupted sleep; I will add only events I remember.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not fill unknown parts with continuous sleep and will record events you remember. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのメモを診療担当へお見せください。睡眠の状態は、説明を合わせて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show those notes to your clinician. They will assess your sleep together with your explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。布団にいた七時間と眠った長さを同じにせず、分かる時刻と不明な部分を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 床上時間と睡眠時間を分け確定時刻と未知部分を診療者へ伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will not equate seven hours in bed with the length of sleep; I will explain the times I know and the unknown parts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will distinguish time in bed from sleep time and tell the clinician the certain times and unknown parts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 寝床に入った時刻と、眠り始めた時刻が分からないことを、メモと一緒に担当へお伝えください。それでは、診察の案内をお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please tell the person responsible when you got into bed and that you do not know when you fell asleep, along with your notes. Please wait for instructions for your examination. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 昨夜聞こえた声について、ご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss the voice you heard last night, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 隣の方から大きな声が聞こえて心配です。助けを求めるように聞こえましたが、テレビの声だったのか、人が話したのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 助けを求めるような声を聞いたがテレビか人か不明と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am worried because I heard a loud voice from next door. It sounded like a call for help, but I do not know whether it was a television or a person speaking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Consult about a voice that sounded like a call for help, but whose source, television or person, is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身がいた場所と、聞こえた様子を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me where you were and what you heard.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分の部屋にいて窓を閉めていました。言葉は一部しか聞き取れず、相手の姿や部屋の中は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自室で閉窓のため一部のみ聴取し姿や内部は見ていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was in my room with the window closed. I could make out only some words, and I did not see the person or inside the room.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you heard only parts from your room with the window closed and did not see the person or inside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見たことと聞いたことを分けて伺います。今も同じ声が聞こえる状態でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will ask separately about what you saw and heard. Can you still hear the same voice now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今は聞こえません。昨夜のことを相談しに来ました。今、誰かが殴られていると自分で決めて話すつもりではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今は声なしで昨夜の相談と現在の暴力断定を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I cannot hear it now. I came to discuss last night. I do not intend to decide for myself and report that someone is being hit right now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish your consultation about last night, with no voice now, from a definite claim of current violence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 昨夜の状況として記録します。声の出所について、ほかに確かめたことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will record it as last night's situation. Have you checked anything else about the source of the voice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありません。確かめるために隣の家へ入ったり、窓からのぞいたりはしていません。方向と聞こえた時間を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 出所未確認で侵入や覗きはせず方向と時間を説明すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I did not enter the neighbor's home or look through the window to check. I will explain the direction and time I heard it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the source is unconfirmed, you did not intrude or peek, and will explain direction and time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が事情を伺います。音の内容だけで、ご自身で安全や原因を断定しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person responsible will ask about the circumstances. Please do not determine safety or the cause yourself from the sound alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。聞いた言葉は曖昧なまま正確に伝え、発生元や現在の状況で不明な所も担当へ話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原因や安全を自分で断定せず不明な言葉と発生元を担当へ伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will accurately convey the words I heard while preserving their uncertainty, and tell the person responsible what is unknown about the source and current situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not determine the cause or safety yourself and will tell the person responsible about uncertain words and source. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 昨夜聞こえた声について、時刻と方向、確認できていない点を担当に引き継ぎます。それでは、担当の案内をお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass on the time, direction, and unconfirmed points about last night's voice to the person responsible. Please wait for their guidance. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの本をお返しするための発送ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are sending this book back, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、友人から借りた本です。自分のメモを挟んだまま持って来たので、このまま送る前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借りた本に私的メモを挟んだまま返送前に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I borrowed it from a friend. I brought it with my own notes still tucked inside, so I want to check before sending it as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to check personal notes left in a borrowed book before returning it by mail. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ発送の準備は終わっていませんね。中身はご自身で整理してからお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not finished preparing it for sending yet, correct? Please organize the contents yourself before bringing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。自分の仕事の予定も書いたメモがあります。借りた本を返すことと、その情報を友人へ渡すことは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未準備で本の返却と仕事予定の共有は別と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Some notes include my work schedule. Returning the borrowed book and giving that information to my friend are separate things.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is not ready and returning the book differs from sharing your work schedule. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本に最初から入っていた物まで、まとめて捨てないようご自身でお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check for yourself so you do not throw away everything, including things originally in the book.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人の付箋か自分のメモか不明な物もあるので、全部取り出して捨てるのではなく、本人へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 付箋の所有不明で全廃棄せず持ち主へ確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Some things may be my friend's sticky notes or my own notes; I do not know. I will check with the owner rather than take everything out and throw it away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say ownership of sticky notes is unclear, so you will check with the owner rather than discard everything. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内容が整いましたら、包んだ状態で発送方法をご相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once the contents are sorted out, you can discuss shipping methods with it wrapped.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。友人から預かった物は確認して残し、自分の私的なメモは手元へ戻します。本のページを切って済ませるつもりではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 預かり物を残し私的メモを戻し本を傷めて済ませないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will check and keep what my friend entrusted to me, and take back my personal notes. I do not intend to solve it by cutting pages out of the book.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will preserve entrusted items, retrieve personal notes, and not deal with it by damaging the book. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご準備をしてから、改めてお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please prepare it and bring it again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。今日は発送せず、本と付箋の所有を確認して整え、包みも含めて相談に戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発送を保留して内容所有確認と梱包後に相談し直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I will not send it today; I will check ownership of the book and sticky notes, sort them out, and return to discuss it, including the wrapping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will hold off sending it, check ownership of the contents, pack it, and return for advice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 借りた本に挟まっていた紙の持ち主を確認してから包んでください。それでは、発送の準備が整いましたらお越しください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please confirm who owns the papers tucked in the borrowed book before wrapping it. Please return when it is ready to send. Thank you.
